title: False projection chart-factor cancellation
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $N\in\mathbf N$ with $(N:A)=0$, and $t$ a normalized finite twist transport system [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. Let $S$ be a scheme with $N$ invertible in $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_S$, $q:P\to S$, $P'=\mathbf P^1_P$, $r:P'\to P$, and $v=\mathbf P^1(q):P'\to P$. Work in the ordinary unbounded etale $A$-module derived categories and write $L_T=A_T(1)[2]$ for the concrete shifted finite Tate line. Set $F=Rr_*$ and $U=q^*Rq_*L_P$. Let $e:U\to F(v^*L_P)$ be the specified ordinary projective-line exchange for $q$, and $c:v^*L_P\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{P'}$ the normalized shifted-line pullback comparison for $v$, using the image of the given unit $N$ on $P$. Define the chart factor $a=e\,;\,F(c.\mathrm{hom})$ and its displayed inverse $b=F(c.\mathrm{inv})\,;\,e^{-1}$, where semicolon means first the left arrow, then the right arrow. Then $a\,;\,b=1_U$.

proof.text: Install invertibility of the ordinary projective-line exchange using lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-exchange-iso, and unfold the displayed chart factor and its inverse.

Reassociate the composite. Cancel the pushforward images of the shifted-line isomorphism and its inverse by Mathlib Iso.map_hom_inv_id_assoc, then cancel the exchange with its inverse by IsIso.hom_inv_id. The result is the identity.
